verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate or be forced into a variant for testing or QA. Its first-feature tutorial explicitly targets internal testers, which covers individual-user targeting for allowlists and beta testers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding specific users (deny-list overrides), details on managing override lists (e.g., by ID or email, bulk upload), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)
